verdict.rationale: New Relic documents NerdGraph, a GraphQL API for querying its data. It also documents NRQL, a SQL-like query language for troubleshooting, and an official MCP server that lets external AI tools ask plain-English questions that are converted to NRQL. On top of that, it ships a CLI with JSON output intended for fetching data while troubleshooting, plus an `nr1 nrql` command. missing for 10: explicit evidence that traces specifically can be queried through the API/MCP (traces appear only in log-management context), independent or hands-on corroboration of an external agent debugging production this way.
